cohort: 161 pregnant women scheduled for trial of labor after caesarean delivery, undergoing antepartum ultrasound assessment at 36-38 weeks of gestation
finding: A multiparametric model incorporating maternal height, previous C-section indication, cervical dilation at admission, fetal head circumference, sub-pubic angle, and cervical length can effectively predict vaginal birth after caesarean section.
mod_finding: Maternal height, previous cesarean section for arrest of labor, cervical dilation at admission, fetal head circumference, subpubic angle, and cervical length were independently associated with successful vaginal birth after cesarean section.
